data.subject: Local Ledger for Mendon
data.body:
Hi,

Mendon Capital Advisors Corp.'s most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in FCBM and FRST.

FCBM's Q2 2026 revenue was $5.5M versus $12.1M a year earlier, down 54.2% year over year (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1531193/000162828026056931/0001628280-26-056931-index.htm).

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records—permits, agendas, call reports, and filings—with every claim cited.

I can send the free weekly issue or set up a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
